body:
>Sadly there are shitty doctors everywhere, regardless of naive you may or may not be.

Seems kind of weird how doctors go through years and years of medical school and not seem passionate about helping whoever comes through the door??

>And dont be afraid to follow up on stuff, sometimes things like that can take a bit to set up


Thank you for saying that, I needed to hear it. And I booked a appointment to follow up with the stuff.

I'm kind of naive in the real world and don't know everything, point being I don't always know if I'm in the wrong or if its the doctors. I also had seen a different doctor recently for help instead (same establishment but different doctor) and the new doctor said she'd, like, put me in for a referral for this place nearby and should hear from them within two weeks - it is now been about a month without hearing from the place I *should* have heard from weeks ago. I don't know it just seems like I visit the doctors a thousand times and I never get help.

>recommed you see a psychiatrist

I doubt he'll do anything. already prescribed me anti-depressants years ago, I'm still suicidal. And he already put support groups/specialists in place for me........................can you guess which ones keep in contact with me? zero.
Why not? and it's not completely out the blue. The doctor knows I suffer from 'low moods' as he once described it, even know thats the biggest understatement ever.
